thread:
Katie: 🚀 kickoff: compact pricing UX sprint — quick sync. Goal: reduce cognitive load on pricing page and test a smaller calculator flow.
Jamal: 👍 timeline? can we get an MVT by next Wed?
Katie: aiming for a lightweight A/B by Tue evening. Dev can ship minimal calc + simplified tiers.
Maria: I'll draft FAQ microcopy updates today. focus on 3 Qs: metering, dedicated vs hosted, enterprise billing.
Ethan: for the calculator, suggest we drop advanced options behind a 'more settings' toggle to reduce initial choices.
Olivia: agree. also change CTA from "Estimate" to "See pricing" in variant B — small phrasing test.
Jamal: telemetry checklist: event names and props? need: variant_id, session_len, calc_inputs, conversion_click.
Katie: use event names: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_cta_click. Put this in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/compact-pricing-sprint (WIP)
Maria: microcopy draft: Q1: "How are tokens metered?" Answer: one-line then link to docs. Q2: "Can I reserve capacity?" short answer + CTA to Dedicated page. Q3: "How do you handle data/privacy?" link to compliance page.
Ethan: dev question — we need the calc to return estimates in <500ms for common inputs. fallback: show "estimate pending" + email capture.
Olivia: for tier names, lean neutral: Starter / Scale / Enterprise. But we could test "Starter / Dedicated / Enterprise" as a second variant.
Jamal: add a tiny survey trigger for users who run calc 3+ times: "Was this helpful?" to capture intent.
Katie: webinar CTA: include a small inline promo under the calc (variant A) linking to 1/2-hr demo on pricing. track clicks.
Maria: updating FAQ doc now and will paste copy into the sprint page by EOD.
Ethan: I'll drop a tiny JS snippet in staging to capture events. snippet: `window.track('pricing_calc_submit', {variant:'compact-A', inputs: {...}})`
Olivia: can marketing ops build the experiment in Optimizely? @growth-bot can you create the experiment and add the tracking spec?
growth-bot: created experiment "compact_pricing_v1" in Optimizely — experiment id exp_20250321_137. Added draft tracking spec to the experiment.
Jamal: perfect. devs, please ping me when staging is ready so I can QA event payloads.
Katie: thanks team. next check-in tomorrow 10am. deliverables: Maria FAQ copy, Ethan dev snippet in staging, Olivia variants in Optimizely, Jamal telemetry QA. :seedling:
Olivia: one quick ask — can we keep the calculator accessible (keyboard nav + aria labels)? I'll add to acceptance criteria.
Katie: yes — accessibility is required.
Maria: pushing FAQ copy now. will post link when done.
Ethan: staging deploy started. will update thread when live.
growth-bot: deploy succeeded: staging/pricing-compact @1859994365
Katie: awesome, thanks all :tada:
